name: Aita Fumito
source:
A perfectly normal college student (virgin) working at a family restaurant.

He falls in love at first sight with Yuma, whom he meets there, and gradually deepens his friendship with her through his part-time job.

[spoiler]He learns of Yuma's promiscuous past and the lies she told him about it. He accepts it all, feeling lucky that she chose him over any of them[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://rinrin.saiin.net/~j-tuukoudome/myweb1_019.htm]official site[/url]]
